## Abstract
The model family includes both dense (2B/4B/8B/32B) and mixture-of-experts (30B-A3B/235B-A22B) variants to accommodate diverse latency-quality trade-offs.

View more

[View Paper](https://www.alphaxiv.org/pdf/2511.21631)

726

Save

[Comments](https://www.alphaxiv.org/abs/2511.21631#discussion) [QwenLM/Qwen3-VL](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL)

Cite

## AI Overview
Copy

Suppose you need one important moment buried in a long video, and you have to answer a question about it. Qwen3-VL treats a video as visual evidence with explicit time markers, and it is designed to keep far-apart parts of an input in a shared context. In the authors' test, **Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct** reaches 100% accuracy on videos up to 30 minutes, which corresponds to its 256K-token context. It reaches 99.5% accuracy up to 1M tokens, approximately two hours, only when its positions are extended with YaRN.[p25]

The vertical axis is needle depth in the video, from 0% to 100%.

## [Jump to section](https://www.alphaxiv.org/abs/2511.21631#how-time-and-vision-enter-the-model) How time and vision enter the model
The model has three modules.

According to the Qwen3-VL authors, these absolute-time IDs can become large and sparse over long videos.

## [Jump to section](https://www.alphaxiv.org/abs/2511.21631#what-the-long-video-test-shows) What the long-video test shows
The model must locate that frame and answer a question about it.

For Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct, accuracy is 100% on videos up to 30 minutes, which corresponds to 256K tokens.

## [Jump to section](https://www.alphaxiv.org/abs/2511.21631#closing) Closing
It does not show equal performance for every model size, for both Instruct and Thinking modes, or on natural long-video tasks.

# Qwen3-VL
## Introduction
[Permalink: Introduction](https://github.com/qwenlm/qwen3-vl#introduction)

## News
- 2025.10.4: We have released the [Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct) and [Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking). We have also released the FP8 version of the Qwen3-VL models — available in our [HuggingFace collection](https://huggingface.co/collections/Qwen/qwen3-vl-68d2a7c1b8a8afce4ebd2dbe) and [ModelScope collection](https://modelscope.cn/collections/Qwen3-VL-5c7a94c8cb144b).
- 2025.02.20: we have released the [Qwen2.5-VL Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.13923). Alongside the report, we have also released AWQ-quantized models for Qwen2.5-VL in three different sizes: [3B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct-AWQ), [7B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct-AWQ) , and [72B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct-AWQ) parameters.
- 2024.08.30: We have released the [Qwen2-VL series](https://huggingface.co/collections/Qwen/qwen2-vl-66cee7455501d7126940800d). The 2B and 7B models are now available, and the 72B model for open source is coming soon. For more details, please check our [blog](https://qwenlm.github.io/blog/qwen2-vl/)!

## Quickstart
### New `qwen-vl-utils` Usage
```
# for Qwen2.5VL, you can simply call
images, videos, video_kwargs = process_vision_info(messages, return_video_kwargs=True)

# For Qwen3VL series, you should call
images, videos, video_kwargs = process_vision_info(messages, image_patch_size=16, return_video_kwargs=True, return_video_metadata=True)
```

We recommend setting appropriate values for the `min_pixels` and `max_pixels` parameters based on available GPU memory and the specific application scenario to restrict the resolution of individual frames in the video.

## Deployment
### Online Serving
```
# Efficient inference with FP8 checkpoint
# Requires NVIDIA H100+ and CUDA 12+
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct-FP8 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --mm-encoder-tp-mode data \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --async-scheduling \
  --media-io-kwargs '{"video": {"num_frames": -1}}' \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 22002
```

```
import time
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="EMPTY",
    base_url="http://127.0.0.1:22002/v1",
    timeout=3600
)

messages = [\
    {\
        "role": "user",\
        "content": [\
            {\
                "type": "video_url",\
                "video_url": {\
                    "url": "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen2-VL/space_woaudio.mp4"\
                }\
            },\
            {\
                "type": "text",\
                "text": "How long is this video?"\
            }\
        ]\
    }\
]

start = time.time()

# When vLLM is launched with `--media-io-kwargs '{"video": {"num_frames": -1}}'`,
# video frame sampling can be configured via `extra_body` (e.g., by setting `fps`).
# This feature is currently supported only in vLLM.
#
# By default, `fps=2` and `do_sample_frames=True`.
# With `do_sample_frames=True`, you can customize the `fps` value to set your desired video sampling rate.
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct-FP8",
    messages=messages,
    max_tokens=2048,
    extra_body={"mm_processor_kwargs": {"fps": 2, "do_sample_frames": True}}
)

print(f"Response costs: {time.time() - start:.2f}s")
print(f"Generated text: {response.choices[0].message.content}")
```

web.title: Deploy Qwen3.5-Omni on GPU Cloud: Self-Host Real-Time ...
web.description:
## Step-by-Step Deployment with vLLM on Spheron GPU Cloud
### Step 3: Download Model Weights
```
pip install huggingface_hub
huggingface-cli download Qwen/Qwen3.5-Omni \
  --local-dir /data/models/qwen3.5-omni
```

### Step 4: Launch the Inference Server
```
vllm serve /data/models/qwen3.5-omni \
  --dtype float16 \
  --quantization bitsandbytes \
  --load-format bitsandbytes \
  --max-model-len 8192 \
  --port 8000 \
  --trust-remote-code
```

## Real-Time Inference Latency: Voice, Video, and Text Pipelines
**Video input.** For a 5-second video at 2fps (10 frames), expect 15-30ms of encoder preprocessing.

## Quick Setup Guide
### Launch the vLLM inference server
For FP16 on H100: vllm serve /data/models/qwen3.5-omni --dtype bfloat16 --max-model-len 8192 --port 8000 --trust-remote-code. Set --max-model-len based on your audio/video input lengths.

## Frequently Asked Questions
### 01What is Qwen3.5-Omni and how is it different from Qwen3-VL?
The model uses a 30B MoE architecture with 3B active parameters per token.

# Introduction to Qwen3-VL
[Sovit Ranjan RathSovit Ranjan Rath](https://debuggercafe.com/author/sovit-ranjan-rath/)[December 15, 2025December 15, 2025](https://debuggercafe.com/2025/12/15/)3 Comments

![Introduction to Qwen3-VL](https://debuggercafe.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Introduction_to_Qwen3_VL_FeaturedImage_1000x563.png)

**Qwen3-VL** is the latest iteration in the Qwen Vision Language model family. It is the most powerful series of models to date in the Qwen-VL family. With models ranging from different sizes to separate **_instruct_** and **_thinking_** models, Qwen3-VL has a lot to offer.

As the official report or a paper has not been published yet, we will infer as much as we can from the official blog post.

**_Along with that, we will cover the following inference tasks with Qwen3-VL_**:

## Model Performance and Benchmarks
The evaluation covers ten dimensions, including STEM reasoning, general VQA, 2D/3D grounding, video understanding, and agent capabilities.

## Core Capabilities of Qwen3-VL
### Long-Context and Video Understanding
This allows the model to process hundreds of pages of documents or even videos up to two hours long.

## Inference Experiments Using Qwen3-VL
### Video Understanding Using Qwen3-VL 4B
Let’s load the model, provide a video file path, and visualize a few frames.

web.title: Qwen3-VL: Sharper Vision, Deeper Thought, Broader Action
web.description:
# Qwen3-VL: Sharper Vision, Deeper Thought, Broader Action
![1](https://yqintl.alicdn.com/d242576467cdd28922cc4d758be41d2c3e1bcbdb.png)

In this generation, we’ve made major improvements across multiple dimensions: whether it’s understanding and generating text, perceiving and reasoning about visual content, supporting longer context lengths, understanding spatial relationships and dynamic videos, or interacting with AI agents — Qwen3-VL shows clear and significant progress in every area.

## Key Highlights:
- **Long Context & Long Video Understanding:** All models natively support 256K tokens of context, expandable up to 1 million tokens. This means you can input hundreds of pages of technical documents, entire textbooks, or even two-hour videos — and the model will remember everything and retrieve details accurately, down to the exact second in videos.

## Model Updates
The original MRoPE divides the feature dimensions into blocks along the order of time (t), height (h), and width (w), causing all temporal information to be concentrated in high-frequency dimensions. In Qwen3-VL, we instead distribute t, h, and w in an interleaved manner, achieving full-frequency coverage across time, height, and width. This more robust positional encoding ensures comparable image understanding capability while significantly improving long video comprehension.
